concerns.text: Task T014 (download and preprocess a third verified benchmark) is placed after the full training‑generation (T005), metric computation (T006‑T010), and reporting tasks (T011‑T013). This violates the foundational‑tasks‑first principle: the third dataset must be loaded and preprocessed before any model training, synthetic generation, or metric computation that are expected to include it. As a result, earlier tasks would run without the third dataset, breaking the intended end‑to‑end reproducibility and the independent shippability of User Story 1.
